title: Geriatrics  Gerontology And Care Of Persons With Disabilities
modules: Ethical And Medico - Legal Issues In The Elderly
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a specialist who works to promote health in the elderly while treating other diseases that older adults are prone to."
A geriatrician is a specialist who works to promote health in the elderly while treating other diseases that older adults are prone to.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a veritable tool in getting the injured or disabled patient to attain functionality as quickly as possible."
Rehabilitation of the disabled is a veritable tool in getting the injured or disabled patient to attain functionality as quickly as possible.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the major causes of disability and dependency among older people worldwide."
Dementia is one of the major causes of disability and dependency among older people worldwide.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the branch of medicine concerned with the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of disease in older people and the problems specific to aging."
Geriatrics can be defined as the branch of medicine concerned with the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of disease in older people and the problems specific to aging.
fib: ______ is the study of the aging process and the problems the elderly might encounter.
Gerontology is the study of the aging process and the problems the elderly might encounter.
______ is defined as a decreased ability to see to a degree that causes problems not fixable by usual means, such as glasses or medication.
Vision disability Vision impairment is defined as a decreased ability to see to a degree that causes problems not fixable by usual means, such as glasses or medication.
______ is the manner by which the impairment restricts the normal functioning of the individual.
A handicap is the manner by which the impairment restricts the normal functioning of the individual.
